extracted.intended_audience: beginning Russian students and first-year Russian teachers
extracted.subtask_description: A free, web-based, first-year Russian textbook organized around four American students' experiences; includes student-facing lessons and teacher materials for classroom use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive introduction to Russian language and culture
rubrics_metrics.description: Между нами is a free, web-based textbook that provides a comprehensive introduction to Russian language and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The textbook aims to cover both language and cultural knowledge across a first-year curriculum; it is presented online and available at no cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative/contextualized organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Organized around the experiences of four American students, each spending the academic year in a different Russian city.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Their interactions with host families, roommates, fellow students and teachers create a universe of contextualized information that motivates the use of the target language in the classroom. The program uses these recurring characters and situations to situate vocabulary, grammar, and culture within meaningful contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lesson structure with explicit goals and segmented parts
rubrics_metrics.description: Each lesson (Урок) includes 'Goals for Урок X' and is divided into parts (Часть 1, Часть 2, Часть 3) with numbered segments (e.g., 1.1, 1.2...).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lessons present discrete topical segments (dialogues, readings, etc.) and provide a 'Новые слова for Урок X (pdf)' vocabulary packet for each lesson, implying a consistent, modular lesson plan structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Teacher materials and classroom support
rubrics_metrics.description: For Teachers: Между нами is a complete first-year program with daily lesson plans, structured classroom activities, written homework and sample schedules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site explicitly provides teacher-facing resources designed to enable daily planning and in-class activities; these materials are intended to support implementation of the course in classroom settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Getting started guidance and learner orientation
rubrics_metrics.description: Getting Started: Learn about the main characters in Между нами, and how to use the program components to get the most out of your study of Russian.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The textbook includes orientation material that explains program components and recommended ways for learners to engage with those components to maximize learning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explicit mapping of content, vocabulary, grammar, and culture within a narrative arc
rubrics_metrics.description: Contents: Explore the structure of Между нами, and how its approach to content, vocabulary, grammar and culture unfold within the story's narrative arc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program presents how different strands (vocabulary/grammar/culture) are introduced and developed over time through the ongoing story, suggesting sequencing and integration as design principles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementary multimedia and reference tables
rubrics_metrics.description: The site provides 'А́удио+' and 'Табли́цы' including Noun Case Usage, Declension Charts, Conjugation Charts, Prepositions, and Spelling Rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These auxiliary resources supply pronunciation practice and grammatical reference material to support lesson content; they function as required reference aids for learners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Per-lesson vocabulary packets
rubrics_metrics.description: Each lesson links to 'Но́вые слова́ for Уро́к X (pdf)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vocabulary is packaged per lesson as downloadable PDFs, implying a standard expectation that learners study and review 'new words' associated with each lesson unit.
